key_insight: ATACOM-DC improves safe RL by enforcing constraints only when an action moves toward a boundary, preserving more task performance than always-on safety filtering.
engineering_relevance: This makes safe robotic control more practical in real systems by reducing unnecessary constraint interference while still preventing unsafe behavior.
method: Extends ATACOM safety layers with directional constraints
Distinguishes actions approaching vs. moving away from constraint limits
Activates enforcement only when constraint violation is becoming likely
evidence_signal: The method is evaluated on multiple challenging simulated robotic control tasks, comparing both constraint-violation costs and achieved task performance.
watch_item: Performance gains are reported in simulation, so real-world effectiveness may depend on accurate constraint models and stable detection of boundary-directed actions.
paper_title: Directional Constraints for Efficient Exploration in Safe Reinforcement Learning
